host.label: Robot IP address
host.help: Local IPv4 address of the Roidmi EVE Plus

did.label: Xiaomi device DID
did.help: Numeric device ID (DID) from the Xiaomi device details or MIoT logs. Required for MIoT requests.

token.label: MIoT / miIO token
token.help: Stored encrypted by ioBroker. Never share this token.

cloudEnabled.label: Optional: Enable Xiaomi Cloud map retrieval
cloudEnabled.help: Only needed to automatically download saved maps and room names/IDs. Local robot control and status polling work without this option. Cloud access is only used when control.refreshMap is pressed.

cloudUsername.label: Xiaomi account username (optional)
cloudUsername.help: Only used for optional Xiaomi Cloud map retrieval.

cloudPassword.label: Xiaomi account password (optional)
cloudPassword.help: Stored encrypted by ioBroker. Never share it in chat or logs.

cloudCountry.label: Xiaomi Cloud region
cloudCountry.help: Two-letter account region, e.g. de, fr, it, es or cn.
